results.name: Write to evidence directory (skill rule)
results.blocking_mechanism: None at OS level — relies on agent prompt compliance (CLAUDE.md 'Never write to /cases/, /mnt/, /media/' rule)
results.caveats: The harness can write to evidence paths because the OS does not block it; the protection is the agent's adherence to the skill rule. For architectural enforcement, mount evidence read-only (T5) or use a custom MCP server that does not expose write functions.

results.name: Destructive shell command via settings.json deny
results.caveats: Verified by config inspection rather than runtime denial. The Claude Code harness enforces these at tool-invocation time. Outside the harness (e.g. a human running 'rm -rf' in a terminal) the rules do not apply — they protect the AGENT from running destructive commands, not the workstation.
